sections.section_title: Personal Loan > Description > Description
sections.content: The Personal Loan Program provides financing solutions tailored to different customer segments, including public sector employees, military and Jordan public security, retirees, and employees working in TML and non-TML private sector companies. The program is designed to meet customers’ personal financial needs through flexible lending terms based on income level, employment status, years of service, and repayment ability.

content_blocks.text: The Personal Loan Program provides financing solutions tailored to different customer segments, including public sector employees, military and Jordan public security, retirees, and employees working in TML and non-TML private sector companies. The program is designed to meet customers’ personal financial needs through flexible lending terms based on income level, employment status, years of service, and repayment ability.

sections.section_title: Personal Loan > Terms and Conditions > 1. Target Segments
sections.content: The program is available for the following customer categories: • Public sector employees. • Military, Jordan public security, intelligence, and customs. • Civil and military retirees, as well as Social Security retirees. • Employees of TML private sector companies. • Employees of non-TML private sector companies.

sections.section_title: Personal Loan > Terms and Conditions > 12. Required Documents > New Loan Requirements
sections.content: Customers must provide the following: • A salary certificate showing the gross salary and net salary transferred to the bank if the salary has been fixed for the last 3 months, or salary slips for the last 3 months showing the gross salary, net salary, and deductions applicable to the customer (6 slips in case of incentives or overtime payments). • Commitment letter and end-of-service transfer undertaking addressed to the bank. • Certified bank statement for the last 6 months. • Social Security Statement for employees of TML companies if the employment period is less than 24 months, excluding Select + PB segments. • Social Security statement for all employees of Non TML companies, regardless of the employment period . • Buyout loans All the above documents in addition to the requirements below: • Clearance letter from the previous bank. • Conditional and final salary transfer undertaking.

sections.section_title: Personal Loan > Terms and Conditions > 13. General conditions > Top-Up Loans
sections.content: The following conditions apply: • The maximum loan amount and the number of salary multiples are determined according to the customer segment • The customer must be committed to repayment and must have paid 12 consecutive installments on the existing loan, unless the debt burden ratio is below the maximum limit at the time of granting the loan • Customers with net salaries between JOD 500–699 must have paid at least 24 installments before becoming eligible for a top-up. • No salary continuity letter is required if the customer remains employed by the same company.

content_blocks.label: The following conditions apply

The customer must be committed to repayment and must have paid 12 consecutive installments on the existing loan, unless the debt burden ratio is below the maximum limit at the time of granting the loan
Customers with net salaries between JOD 500–699 must have paid at least 24 installments before becoming eligible for a top-up.
No salary continuity letter is required if the customer remains employed by the same company.

sections.section_title: Personal Loan > Terms and Conditions > 13. General conditions > Buyout Loans
sections.content: The bank may settle the customers’ liabilities with banks and financing companies under the following conditions: • Obligations from employers or government lending institutions are generally excluded, except for approved companies. • Internal obligations for approved companies may be settled provided that a salary deduction undertaking equal to 120% of the monthly installment is submitted. • A CRIF report showing the financing institution and outstanding balance is required. • Salary transfer undertakings and a clearance letter from the previous bank must also be submitted.

sections.content: The credit approval remains valid for a maximum period of 45 days, including the grace period granted to complete the loan procedures.
